text: {"lessons":["My account has grown overall despite monthly setbacks, reinforcing that I should avoid reacting to short-term volatility without a clear reason.","Selling part of Stock B after a large gain reduced that position, but a gain versus my average cost alone does not tell me whether selling was the best choice; I should consider its role in my portfolio and my goals.","Since I rarely trade, I should still periodically review diversification and risk, and make any needed changes deliberately within my cash and holdings."]}
